facts.text: All undergraduate students are required to take two multidisciplinary Interprofessional Projects (IPRO) courses addressing industry and community challenges.

sources.title: Inter-Professional Projects Program (IPRO) - Illinois Tech | Elevate
sources.quote: All undergraduate students must complete two IPRO courses, in which multi-disciplinary student teams are tasked with finding solutions to problems impacting business, industry, or the world at large.
